இந்த வினவலைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
2021 ஆம் ஆண்டில் இளம்பருவ டெட்டனஸ் தடுப்பூசிகள் (TT10/TD10) பதிவு செய்யப்பட்ட, ஆனால் அதே ஆண்டில் ஐந்து வயதுக்கு மேற்பட்ட குழந்தைகளுக்கான DPT இரண்டாம் பூஸ்டர் தடுப்பூசிகள் எதுவும் பதிவு செய்யாத துணை மாவட்டங்களை அடையாளம் காணவும்.

english_question: Identify the sub-districts that reported at least one child over five years old receiving the second DPT booster in 2021, specifically across both rural and urban areas.
translated_question:
இந்த வினாவை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
2021 ஆம் ஆண்டில், குறைந்தது ஒரு குழந்தைக்கு ஐந்து வயதுக்கு மேற்பட்ட குழந்தைகள் இரண்டாவது டிபிடி பூஸ்டர் பெற்றதாக அறிவிக்கப்பட்ட துணை மாவட்டங்களை அடையாளம் காணவும், குறிப்பாக கிராமப்புற மற்றும் நகர்ப்புற பகுதிகள் முழுவதும்.

english_question: Identify the sub-districts that recorded at least one child receiving the second DPT booster (DPT 5) in 2021 across both rural and urban areas.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:

english_question: Identify the sub-districts that recorded at least one child receiving the second DPT booster (after age 5) in 2021 across both urban and rural areas, listed alphabetically.

english_question: Identify all Christian households with an asset index greater than 10 that are involved in at least one business activity, sorted by their asset index in descending order.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
10 కంటే ఎక్కువ ఆస్తి సూచిక కలిగి, కనీసం ఒక వ్యాపార కార్యకలాపంలో నిమగ్నమైన అన్ని క్రైస్తవ గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, వాటి ఆస్తి సూచికను అవరోహణ క్రమంలో క్రమబద్ధీకరించండి.

english_question: Provide the full social and income profiles for households that are either identified as Muslim or are involved in business activity subtype 40.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ముస్లిం గుర్తించబడిన లేదా వ్యాపార కార్యాచరణ ఉపరకం 40లో పాల్గొన్న గృహాల పూర్తి సామాజిక మరియు ఆదాయ వివరాలను అందించండి.

english_question: Identify all households that either belong to the Muslim social group or are involved in business activity subtype 40, sorted by their ID.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ముస్లిం సామాజిక వర్గానికి చెందిన లేదా వ్యాపార కార్యకలాప ఉపవర్గం 40లో పాల్గొన్న అన్ని గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, వాటి ID ప్రకారం క్రమబద్ధీకరించబడినవి.

english_question: Provide the household IDs and monthly non-food expenditure amounts for rural households located in Maharashtra.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
మహారాష్ట్రలోని గ్రామీణ గృహాల కోసం గృహ ఐడీలు మరియు నెలవారీ ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు మొత్తాలను అందించండి.

english_question: List the household IDs and their monthly non-food expenditures for rural areas in the state of Maharashtra.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
మహారాష్ట్ర రాష్ట్రంలోని గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాల్లోని గృహ ఐడీలు మరియు వారి నెలవారీ ఆహారేతర ఖర్చులను జాబితా చేయండి.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of average monthly per capita consumption and non-food expenses, comparing urban and rural areas based on the 2001 census.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
2001 జనగణన ఆధారంగా, పట్టణ మరియు గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాలను పోల్చి, సగటు నెలవారీ తలసరి వినియోగం మరియు ఆహారేతర ఖర్చుల రాష్ట్ర వారీ వివరణను అందించండి.

english_question: Provide a breakdown by state and urban/rural classification of the average monthly per capita consumption and non-food expenses, focusing only on areas where the average consumption exceeds 329, sorted from highest to lowest.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
రాష్ట్రం మరియు పట్టణ/గ్రామీణ వర్గీకరణ ప్రకారం సగటు నెలవారీ తలసరి వినియోగం మరియు ఆహారేతర ఖర్చుల వివరణను అందించండి, ఇక్కడ సగటు వినియోగం 329 మించిన ప్రాంతాలపై మాత్రమే దృష్టి పెట్టండి, అత్యధికం నుండి తక్కువ వరకు క్రమబద్ధీకరించండి.

english_question: Identify the rural households with either 3 or 5 workers whose monthly non-food spending exceeds 450 rupees.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
3 లేదా 5 మంది కార్మికులు ఉన్న గ్రామీణ గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, వారి నెలవారీ ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు 450 రూపాయలను మించి ఉంటుంది.

english_question: Compare the average monthly non-food spending and per capita consumption between urban and rural areas, focusing only on those regions where the average non-food expenditure exceeds 66 rupees, and rank the results by consumption level.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
పట్టణ మరియు గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాల మధ్య సగటు నెలవారీ ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు మరియు తలసరి వినియోగాన్ని పోల్చండి, మరియు సగటు ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు 66 రూపాయలను మించిన ప్రాంతాలపై మాత్రమే దృష్టి పెట్టండి, తద్వారా వినియోగ స్థాయి ప్రకారం ఫలితాలను ర్యాంక్ చేయండి.

english_question: Identify the states where the maximum monthly non-food expenditure for urban households does not exceed 5,000 rupees.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ఉపనగరాల గృహాలకు గరిష్ట మాసిక నాన్-ఫుడ్ వ్యయం 5,000 రూపాయలకు మించని రాష్ట్రాలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the states where the maximum monthly non-food expenditure for urban households does not exceed 5,000 rupees.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
అర్బన్ కుటుంబాలకు గరిష్ఠ నెలవారీ ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు 5,000 రూపాయలను మించని రాష్ట్రాలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the states where no urban households have a monthly non-food expenditure exceeding 5,000 rupees.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ఏ రాష్ట్రాలలోనూ నగర గృహాలలో ఎవరికీ నెలసరి ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు 5,000 రూపాయలను మించని స్థితిని గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the codes of rural districts that have at least one household spending less than 500 rupees monthly in total, while also having at least one household whose non-food monthly expenditure exceeds 2,000 rupees, sorted by district code.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
మొత్తంగా నెలకు 500 రూపాయల కంటే తక్కువ ఖర్చు చేస్తున్న కనీసం ఒక గృహం ఉన్నట్లు, అదే సమయంలో ఆహారేతర నెలవారీ ఖర్చు 2,000 రూపాయలను మించిన కనీసం ఒక గృహం కూడా ఉన్న గ్రామీణ జిల్లాల కోడ్లను గుర్తించండి, మరియు వాటిని జిల్లా కోడ్ ప్రకారం క్రమబద్ధీకరించండి.

english_question: Identify the states and district codes where households either spend more than 50,000 rupees monthly or employ five animal care workers.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
అధికంగా 50,000 రూపాయల కంటే ఎక్కువ నెలవారీ ఖర్చు చేసే లేదా ఐదు జంతు సంరక్షణ కార్మికులను నియమించుకునే గృహాలు ఉన్న రాష్ట్రాలు మరియు జిల్లా కోడ్లను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the states and district codes where households either spend more than 60,000 rupees monthly or employ five animal care workers.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
అధికంగా 60,000 రూపాయలు నెలవారీ ఖర్చు చేసే లేదా ఐదు జంతు సంరక్షణ కార్మికులను నియమించుకునే గృహాలు ఉన్న రాష్ట్రాలు మరియు జిల్లా కోడ్లను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: List the states and district codes where the total monthly household expenditure exceeds 50,000 rupees or where there is at least one household with five animal care workers, sorted alphabetically by state.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
రాష్ట్రాలు మరియు జిల్లా కోడ్లను జాబితా చేయండి, ఇక్కడ మొత్తం నెలవారీ గృహ ఖర్చు 50,000 రూపాయలను మించిపోయింది లేదా కనీసం ఒక గృహంలో ఐదు జంతు సంరక్షణ కార్మికులు ఉన్నారు, రాష్ట్రాల వారీగా అక్షర క్రమంలో క్రమబద్ధీకరించబడింది.

english_question: Identify the household IDs for families categorized as OBC who fall under the 17th asset index group.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
OBC వర్గంలో ఉన్న కుటుంబాల గృహ ID లను గుర్తించండి, ఇవి 17వ ఆస్తి సూచిక సమూహంలో ఉన్నాయి.

english_question: Provide the household and person case IDs for all households categorized as OBC that fall within the 15th asset index, sorted by household ID.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
OBCగా వర్గీకరించబడిన మరియు 15వ ఆస్తి సూచికలో ఉన్న అన్ని గృహాల కోసం గృహ మరియు వ్యక్తి కేసు IDలను అందించండి, గృహ ID ద్వారా క్రమబద్ధీకరించబడింది.

english_question: List the IDs and social group categories of the ten households with the highest total expenditure on staples like rice, wheat, and pulses.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
బియ్యం, గోధుమలు మరియు పప్పులు వంటి ప్రధాన ఆహార పదార్థాలపై అత్యధిక మొత్తం ఖర్చు చేసిన పది కుటుంబాల ID లు మరియు సామాజిక వర్గాలను జాబితా చేయండి.

english_question: Identify the top 10 households with the highest total spending on rice, wheat, and pulses, and include their respective caste or religious group categories.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
బియ్యం, గోధుమలు మరియు పప్పులపై అత్యధిక మొత్తం ఖర్చు చేసిన మొదటి 10 కుటుంబాలను గుర్తించండి మరియు వారి వర్గం లేదా మత సమూహాలను కూడా చేర్చండి.

english_question: Identify the top 10 households with the highest total spending on staples—specifically rice, wheat, and pulses—where the combined expenditure exceeds 50 rupees, including their social category details.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
స్టేపుల్స్—ముఖ్యంగా బియ్యం, గోధుమలు మరియు పప్పులు—పై అత్యధిక మొత్తం ఖర్చు చేసిన టాప్ 10 గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, ఇక్కడ మొత్తం ఖర్చు 50 రూపాయలను మించి ఉంటుంది, వారి సామాజిక వర్గ వివరాలతో సహా.

english_question: Identify the household IDs for families that have an asset index of 27 and reported zero expenditure on milk.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
27 ఆస్తి సూచిక కలిగిన మరియు పాలపై ఖర్చు సున్నా అని నివేదించిన కుటుంబాల గృహ ఐడిలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the household IDs with an asset index of 27 that have no recorded expenditure on milk consumption.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
27 ఆస్తి సూచిక కలిగిన, పాల వినియోగంపై ఏ రికార్డు చేయని ఖర్చు లేని గృహ సంఖ్యలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify all households that have at least one animal care worker and a social asset index of 27.
translated_question: ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి: కనీసం ఒక జంతు సంరక్షణ కార్మికుడు మరియు 27 సామాజిక ఆస్తి సూచిక కలిగి ఉన్న అన్ని గృహాలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify all households that have at least five animal care workers and an asset index of 17, sorted by their ID.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
కనీసం ఐదు జంతు సంరక్షణ కార్మికులు మరియు 17 ఆస్తి సూచిక కలిగిన అన్ని గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, వాటి ID ప్రకారం క్రమబద్ధీకరించండి.

english_question: Identify all households that either possess an assets index greater than 17 or have at least one member working in animal care.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను అనువదించండి:
అన్ని గృహాలను గుర్తించంగా, వారికి 17 కంటే ఎక్కువ ఆస్తి సూచిక ఉంది లేదా జంతు సంరక్షణలో కనీసం ఒక సభ్యుడు పని చేస్తున్నారు.

english_question: Identify all households that either have an assets index higher than 17 or employ at least one animal care worker, sorted by their ID.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను అనువదించండి:
అన్ని గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, ఇవి 17 కంటే ఎక్కువ ఆస్తి సూచికను కలిగి ఉంటాయి లేదా కనీసం ఒక జంతు సంరక్షణ కార్మికుని నియమించుకుంటాయి, వాటి ID ప్రకారం క్రమబద్ధీకరించబడతాయి.

english_question: List the household IDs, asset indices, and secondary social network contact types for all households in the OBC category, ordered from lowest to highest asset index.

உத்தரப் பிரதேசத்தில் மிக உயர்ந்த சராசரி மாதாந்திர தனிநபர் நுகர்வு கொண்ட முதல் 10 கிராமப்புற பகுதிகளை அடையாளம் காணவும், ஒவ்வொன்றுக்கும் கிராம சுகாதார வசதி உள்ளதா என்பதைக் குறிப்பிடவும்.

english_question: Identify the top 10 rural neighborhoods in Uttar Pradesh with the highest average monthly per capita consumption, noting whether they have access to a village health facility.

உத்தரப் பிரதேசத்தில் அதிக சராசரி மாதாந்திர தனிநபர் நுகர்வு உள்ள முதல் 10 கிராமப்புற பகுதிகளை அடையாளம் காணவும், அவற்றுக்கு கிராம சுகாதார வசதி உள்ளதா என்பதையும் குறிப்பிடவும்.

english_question: Identify all rural areas that have both school and health facilities available, sorted by their geography ID.

english_question: Identify the geographical IDs for areas that either have a village health facility or report a monthly per capita consumption exceeding 3,667, sorted numerically.

ஒரு கிராம சுகாதார வசதி உள்ள அல்லது மாதாந்திர தனிநபர் நுகர்வு 3,667 ஐ விட அதிகமாக இருக்கும் பகுதிகளின் புவியியல் ஐடிகளை அடையாளம் காணவும், எண்ணளவில் வரிசைப்படுத்தவும்.

english_question: Identify the household IDs for families with an asset index of 27 where only one Gauna date has been recorded.

english_question: Identify all households that either fall into the highest asset index category or have children whose school enrollment status is unrecorded, sorted by their household ID.

இந்த வினவலை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
மிக உயர்ந்த சொத்து குறியீட்டு வகையில் அடங்கும் அல்லது பள்ளி சேர்க்கை நிலை பதிவு செய்யப்படாத குழந்தைகளைக் கொண்ட அனைத்து குடும்பங்களையும் அடையாளம் காணவும், அவற்றின் குடும்ப அடையாள எண்ணின் படி வரிசைப்படுத்தவும்.

english_question: Provide a breakdown by caste and religion group showing the average household income, total outstanding loans, and the count of animal care workers for each group.

english_question: Identify all OBC households with an asset index of 17 that have at least one recorded income source and a maximum outstanding loan amount of exactly 50,000 rupees, sorted by their household ID.
translated_question:

english_question: Provide the household IDs and total outstanding loan amounts for all OBC households, ordered from highest to lowest asset index.

எல்லா OBC குடும்பங்களுக்கும் வீட்டு அடையாளங்கள் மற்றும் மொத்த நிலுவை கடன் தொகைகளை வழங்கவும், மிக உயர்ந்த முதல் குறைந்த சொத்து குறியீட்டின் படி வரிசைப்படுத்தவும்.

english_question: Identify the household IDs for families that have an asset index of 27 and no members working in animal care.

english_question: Identify the states and district codes where households either spend more than 60,000 rupees monthly or employ five animal care workers.

english_question: List the IDs and social group categories of the ten households with the highest total expenditure on staples like rice, wheat, and pulses.

english_question: List the household IDs and their corresponding caste or religious group categories, ordered by their asset index.

english_question: Identify the household and person case IDs for OBC families that have at least one type-1 social network contact, ordered by household ID.

english_question: Identify all households that are either identified as Muslim or have a recorded date for the Gauna ceremony.

english_question: Identify all household IDs for families that are either Christian or have a recorded date of Gauna, sorted numerically.

english_question: Identify all households that are either identified as Christian or have a recorded Gauna date, sorted by their household ID.

ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులోకి అనువదించండి:
క్రైస్తవులుగా గుర్తించబడిన లేదా రికార్డ్ చేయబడిన గౌణ తేదీ ఉన్న అన్ని గృహాలను వారి గృహ ఐడీ ప్రకారం క్రమబద్ధీకరించి గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of average per capita consumption and total non-food spending, categorized by whether or not the villages have available health facilities.

english_question: Identify all states that have rural areas containing both health facilities and schools, listed in alphabetical order.

గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాల్లో ఆరోగ్య సౌకర్యాలు మరియు పాఠశాలలు రెండూ ఉన్న అన్ని రాష్ట్రాలను అక్షర క్రమంలో జాబితా చేయండి.

english_question: Identify the top 10 rural neighborhoods in Uttar Pradesh with the highest average monthly per capita consumption, noting whether each has access to a village health facility.

english_question: Identify the top 10 rural neighborhoods in Uttar Pradesh with the highest average monthly per capita consumption, noting whether they have access to a village health facility.

english_question: Calculate the average monthly per capita consumption for each district and state, focusing only on areas where village health facilities are available.

english_question: Rank the districts and states by their average monthly per capita consumption, focusing only on areas with available village health facilities and more than one household record.

english_question: Identify the codes of districts that contain rural villages with access to health facilities but no available drinking water, sorted by district code.

english_question: Identify the IDs of rural villages that have both a school and a health facility, and have recorded at least one household consumption entry, sorted numerically.

english_question: Identify the geography IDs for areas that either have a village health facility or a monthly per capita consumption exceeding 3,667, ensuring only locations with at least one recorded consumption entry are included.

english_question: List the household IDs and their respective caste or religious group categories, ranked from highest to lowest based on their asset index.

english_question: List the household IDs and their corresponding caste or religious categories, ordered from highest to lowest asset index.

english_question: Identify the top 10 wealthiest OBC households by asset index and show their total outstanding loan amounts.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ఆస్తి సూచిక ప్రకారం అత్యంత ధనవంతులైన OBC కుటుంబాలలో మొదటి 10 కుటుంబాలను గుర్తించండి మరియు వారి మొత్తం బకాయి రుణ మొత్తాలను చూపించండి.

english_question: Identify the top 10 OBC households with the highest asset index, showing their household IDs and total number of income sources, filtered for those with a social ID average greater than one.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
సామాజిక ID సగటు ఒకటి కంటే ఎక్కువ ఉన్న వారికి ఫిల్టర్ చేయబడిన, అత్యధిక ఆస్తి సూచిక కలిగిన టాప్ 10 OBC గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, వారి గృహ IDలు మరియు మొత్తం ఆదాయ వనరుల సంఖ్యను చూపండి.

english_question: Provide the household asset index and social-religious category for households that are involved in business activity subtype 40 and currently have outstanding loans.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
వ్యాపార కార్యకలాపాల ఉపవర్గం 40లో పాల్గొని, ప్రస్తుతం బకాయి రుణాలు ఉన్న గృహాల కోసం గృహ ఆస్తి సూచిక మరియు సామాజిక-మత వర్గాన్ని అందించండి.

english_question: Provide a breakdown of households with outstanding loans involved in activity subtype 40, categorized by their asset index and caste-religion group.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
కార్యాచరణ ఉపరకం 40లో పాల్గొన్న బకాయి రుణాలు ఉన్న గృహాల వివరణను, వారి ఆస్తి సూచిక మరియు కుల-మత సమూహం ఆధారంగా వర్గీకరించి అందించంగా.

english_question: Provide a breakdown of household counts by asset index and social group for families that are both engaged in business activities and currently carry outstanding loans.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
వ్యాపార కార్యకలాపాల్లో నిమగ్నమైన మరియు ప్రస్తుతం బాకీలు ఉన్న రుణాలను కలిగి ఉన్న కుటుంబాలకు ఆస్తి సూచిక మరియు సామాజిక వర్గం ద్వారా గృహాల గణన వివరణను అందించండి.

english_question: Identify the household IDs for families that have an asset index of 27 and no members working in animal care.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
27 ఆస్తి సూచిక కలిగి ఉన్న మరియు జంతు సంరక్షణలో ఎవరూ పనిచేయని కుటుంబాల గృహ ఐడిలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: List the IDs of households that have an asset index of 27 and no reported animal care workers, ordered by their ID.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
27 ఆస్తి సూచిక కలిగి ఉన్న మరియు నివేదించబడిన జంతు సంరక్షణ కార్మికులు లేని గృహాల ID లను వారి ID ప్రకారం క్రమబద్ధీకరించి జాబితా చేయండి.

english_question: Identify all households with an asset index of 27 that do not have any animal care workers, sorted by their ID.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
27 ఆస్తి సూచిక ఉన్న మరియు జంతువుల సంరక్షణ కార్యకర్తులు లేని అన్ని గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, వాటి ID ప్రకారం క్రమబద్ధీకరించండి.

english_question: Identify all Christian households with an asset index greater than 10 that are involved in at least one business activity, sorted by their asset index in descending order.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
10 కంటే ఎక్కువ ఆస్తి సూచిక కలిగి, కనీసం ఒక వ్యాపార కార్యకలాపంలో నిమగ్నమైన అన్ని క్రైస్తవ గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, వాటి ఆస్తి సూచికను అవరోహణ క్రమంలో క్రమబద్ధీకరించండి.

english_question: Provide the full social and income profiles for households that are either identified as Muslim or are involved in business activity subtype 40.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ముస్లిం గుర్తించబడిన లేదా వ్యాపార కార్యాచరణ ఉపరకం 40లో పాల్గొన్న గృహాల పూర్తి సామాజిక మరియు ఆదాయ వివరాలను అందించండి.

english_question: Identify all households that either belong to the Muslim social group or are involved in business activity subtype 40, sorted by their ID.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ముస్లిం సామాజిక వర్గానికి చెందిన లేదా వ్యాపార కార్యకలాప ఉపవర్గం 40లో పాల్గొన్న అన్ని గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, వాటి ID ప్రకారం క్రమబద్ధీకరించబడినవి.

english_question: Provide the household IDs and monthly non-food expenditure amounts for rural households located in Maharashtra.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
మహారాష్ట్రలోని గ్రామీణ గృహాల కోసం గృహ ఐడీలు మరియు నెలవారీ ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు మొత్తాలను అందించండి.

english_question: List the household IDs and their monthly non-food expenditures for rural areas in the state of Maharashtra.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
మహారాష్ట్ర రాష్ట్రంలోని గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాల్లోని గృహ ఐడీలు మరియు వారి నెలవారీ ఆహారేతర ఖర్చులను జాబితా చేయండి.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of average monthly per capita consumption and non-food expenses, comparing urban and rural areas based on the 2001 census.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
2001 జనగణన ఆధారంగా, పట్టణ మరియు గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాలను పోల్చి, సగటు నెలవారీ తలసరి వినియోగం మరియు ఆహారేతర ఖర్చుల రాష్ట్ర వారీ వివరణను అందించండి.

english_question: Provide a breakdown by state and urban/rural classification of the average monthly per capita consumption and non-food expenses, focusing only on areas where the average consumption exceeds 329, sorted from highest to lowest.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
రాష్ట్రం మరియు పట్టణ/గ్రామీణ వర్గీకరణ ప్రకారం సగటు నెలవారీ తలసరి వినియోగం మరియు ఆహారేతర ఖర్చుల వివరణను అందించండి, ఇక్కడ సగటు వినియోగం 329 మించిన ప్రాంతాలపై మాత్రమే దృష్టి పెట్టండి, అత్యధికం నుండి తక్కువ వరకు క్రమబద్ధీకరించండి.

english_question: Identify the rural households with either 3 or 5 workers whose monthly non-food spending exceeds 450 rupees.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
3 లేదా 5 మంది కార్మికులు ఉన్న గ్రామీణ గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, వారి నెలవారీ ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు 450 రూపాయలను మించి ఉంటుంది.

english_question: Compare the average monthly non-food spending and per capita consumption between urban and rural areas, focusing only on those regions where the average non-food expenditure exceeds 66 rupees, and rank the results by consumption level.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
పట్టణ మరియు గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాల మధ్య సగటు నెలవారీ ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు మరియు తలసరి వినియోగాన్ని పోల్చండి, మరియు సగటు ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు 66 రూపాయలను మించిన ప్రాంతాలపై మాత్రమే దృష్టి పెట్టండి, తద్వారా వినియోగ స్థాయి ప్రకారం ఫలితాలను ర్యాంక్ చేయండి.

english_question: Identify the states where the maximum monthly non-food expenditure for urban households does not exceed 5,000 rupees.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ఉపనగరాల గృహాలకు గరిష్ట మాసిక నాన్-ఫుడ్ వ్యయం 5,000 రూపాయలకు మించని రాష్ట్రాలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the states where the maximum monthly non-food expenditure for urban households does not exceed 5,000 rupees.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
అర్బన్ కుటుంబాలకు గరిష్ఠ నెలవారీ ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు 5,000 రూపాయలను మించని రాష్ట్రాలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the states where no urban households have a monthly non-food expenditure exceeding 5,000 rupees.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ఏ రాష్ట్రాలలోనూ నగర గృహాలలో ఎవరికీ నెలసరి ఆహారేతర ఖర్చు 5,000 రూపాయలను మించని స్థితిని గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the codes of rural districts that have at least one household spending less than 500 rupees monthly in total, while also having at least one household whose non-food monthly expenditure exceeds 2,000 rupees, sorted by district code.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
మొత్తంగా నెలకు 500 రూపాయల కంటే తక్కువ ఖర్చు చేస్తున్న కనీసం ఒక గృహం ఉన్నట్లు, అదే సమయంలో ఆహారేతర నెలవారీ ఖర్చు 2,000 రూపాయలను మించిన కనీసం ఒక గృహం కూడా ఉన్న గ్రామీణ జిల్లాల కోడ్లను గుర్తించండి, మరియు వాటిని జిల్లా కోడ్ ప్రకారం క్రమబద్ధీకరించండి.

english_question: Identify the states and district codes where households either spend more than 50,000 rupees monthly or employ five animal care workers.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
అధికంగా 50,000 రూపాయల కంటే ఎక్కువ నెలవారీ ఖర్చు చేసే లేదా ఐదు జంతు సంరక్షణ కార్మికులను నియమించుకునే గృహాలు ఉన్న రాష్ట్రాలు మరియు జిల్లా కోడ్లను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the states and district codes where households either spend more than 60,000 rupees monthly or employ five animal care workers.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
అధికంగా 60,000 రూపాయలు నెలవారీ ఖర్చు చేసే లేదా ఐదు జంతు సంరక్షణ కార్మికులను నియమించుకునే గృహాలు ఉన్న రాష్ట్రాలు మరియు జిల్లా కోడ్లను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: List the states and district codes where the total monthly household expenditure exceeds 50,000 rupees or where there is at least one household with five animal care workers, sorted alphabetically by state.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
రాష్ట్రాలు మరియు జిల్లా కోడ్లను జాబితా చేయండి, ఇక్కడ మొత్తం నెలవారీ గృహ ఖర్చు 50,000 రూపాయలను మించిపోయింది లేదా కనీసం ఒక గృహంలో ఐదు జంతు సంరక్షణ కార్మికులు ఉన్నారు, రాష్ట్రాల వారీగా అక్షర క్రమంలో క్రమబద్ధీకరించబడింది.

english_question: Identify the household IDs for families categorized as OBC who fall under the 17th asset index group.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
OBC వర్గంలో ఉన్న కుటుంబాల గృహ ID లను గుర్తించండి, ఇవి 17వ ఆస్తి సూచిక సమూహంలో ఉన్నాయి.

english_question: Provide the household and person case IDs for all households categorized as OBC that fall within the 15th asset index, sorted by household ID.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
OBCగా వర్గీకరించబడిన మరియు 15వ ఆస్తి సూచికలో ఉన్న అన్ని గృహాల కోసం గృహ మరియు వ్యక్తి కేసు IDలను అందించండి, గృహ ID ద్వారా క్రమబద్ధీకరించబడింది.

english_question: List the IDs and social group categories of the ten households with the highest total expenditure on staples like rice, wheat, and pulses.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:

english_question: Identify the top 10 households with the highest total spending on rice, wheat, and pulses, and include their respective caste or religious group categories.

english_question: Identify the top 10 households with the highest total spending on staples—specifically rice, wheat, and pulses—where the combined expenditure exceeds 50 rupees, including their social category details.

english_question: Identify the household IDs for families that have an asset index of 27 and reported zero expenditure on milk.

english_question: Identify the household IDs with an asset index of 27 that have no recorded expenditure on milk consumption.

english_question: Identify all households that have at least one animal care worker and a social asset index of 27.

english_question: Identify all households that have at least five animal care workers and an asset index of 17, sorted by their ID.

english_question: Identify all households that either possess an assets index greater than 17 or have at least one member working in animal care.

english_question: Identify all households that either have an assets index higher than 17 or employ at least one animal care worker, sorted by their ID.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the total number of household members and married women living in urban areas, focusing only on states with more than five household members and sorting the results by the highest count of married women.

শহুরে এলাকায় বসবাসকারী মোট পরিবারের সদস্য এবং বিবাহিত নারীদের সংখ্যার একটি রাজ্যভিত্তিক বিশ্লেষণ প্রদান করুন, শুধুমাত্র সেই রাজ্যগুলির উপর ফোকাস করুন যেখানে পাঁচের বেশি পরিবারের সদস্য রয়েছে এবং ফলাফলগুলি বিবাহিত নারীদের সর্বোচ্চ সংখ্যা অনুসারে সাজান।

english_question: Identify the geography IDs for households that contain at least three youths aged 15 to 21 and were part of a re-interview survey.

english_question: Identify the states and districts that are either classified as urban or contain households with more than three residents aged 15 to 21.

english_question: Identify the states and districts that are either classified as urban areas or contain households with more than three young residents aged 15 to 21.

english_question: List the states and districts that are either classified as urban or have more than three residents aged 15 to 21, sorted by state and district name.

english_question: List the household IDs and their corresponding asset indices for Dalit households located in rural areas of Uttar Pradesh, ordered by their asset index.

english_question: Provide the household IDs and asset indices for Dalit households in rural Uttar Pradesh, ordered from lowest to highest asset index.

english_question: Provide the average household size and the average number of married women per household, broken down by caste/religion group and urban or rural classification.

english_question: Identify the states and districts that contain at least one household belonging to the Brahmin group or those ranked at a 21 on the household assets index, sorted alphabetically by state.

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 14 and under.

राज्य और शहरी/ग्रामीण स्थिति के अनुसार एक विवरण प्रदान करें जो औसत विवाहित महिलाओं की संख्या और प्रति घर 15 वर्ष से कम उम्र के बच्चों की कुल संख्या दर्शाता हो, केवल उन क्षेत्रों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हुए जहां घरों में औसतन एक से अधिक विवाहित महिलाएं हैं और परिणामों को सबसे अधिक बाल आबादी के आधार पर क्रमबद्ध किया गया हो।

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 14 and under.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
उन सभी शहरी परिवारों की पहचान करें जिनके पास 14 वर्ष और उससे कम उम्र के तीन से अधिक बच्चे हैं।

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 0 to 14, ordered by the total number of children in each household.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
शहरी परिवारों की पहचान करें जिनके पास 0 से 14 वर्ष की आयु के तीन से अधिक बच्चे हैं, प्रत्येक परिवार में बच्चों की कुल संख्या के आधार पर क्रमबद्ध किया गया।

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 0 to 14, listed in ascending order of their IDs.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
शहरी परिवारों की पहचान करें जिनके पास 0 से 14 वर्ष की आयु के तीन से अधिक बच्चे हैं, उनके आईडी के आरोही क्रम में सूचीबद्ध किया गया है।

english_question: Rank the rural districts by the average number of married women per household, including only those districts with more than one household record.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
ग्रामीण जिलों को प्रति घर विवाहित महिलाओं की औसत संख्या के आधार पर रैंक करें, केवल उन जिलों को शामिल करें जिनमें एक से अधिक घर के रिकॉर्ड हैं।

english_question: Identify the top five rural districts with the highest average number of married women per household.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
ऐसे शीर्ष पांच ग्रामीण जिलों की पहचान करें जहां प्रति घर विवाहित महिलाओं की औसत संख्या सबसे अधिक है।

english_question: Identify the five rural districts with the highest average number of married women per household.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
उन पांच ग्रामीण जिलों की पहचान करें जहां प्रति घर विवाहित महिलाओं की औसत संख्या सबसे अधिक है।

english_question: Identify the top 5 rural districts with the highest average number of married women per household, considering only those districts with more than one household record.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
उन शीर्ष 5 ग्रामीण जिलों की पहचान करें जहां प्रति घर विवाहित महिलाओं की औसत संख्या सबसे अधिक है, केवल उन जिलों पर विचार करते हुए जहां एक से अधिक घर के रिकॉर्ड हैं।

english_question: Provide a district-wise breakdown of the total number of married women and children aged 0 to 14 living in urban households, sorted alphabetically by district.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
शहरी घरों में रहने वाली विवाहित महिलाओं और 0 से 14 वर्ष की आयु के बच्चों की कुल संख्या का जिलेवार विवरण प्रदान करें, जिलों के वर्णानुक्रम में क्रमबद्ध किया गया।

english_question: Identify the urban districts where no households were selected for a re-interview during the survey.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
सर्वेक्षण के दौरान पुनः साक्षात्कार के लिए जिन शहरी जिलों में कोई भी घर चयनित नहीं किया गया था, उनकी पहचान करें।

english_question: Identify all districts that either are classified as urban areas or have conducted household re-interviews.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
उन सभी जिलों की पहचान करें जो या तो शहरी क्षेत्रों के रूप में वर्गीकृत हैं या जिन्होंने घरेलू पुनः साक्षात्कार आयोजित किए हैं।

english_question: Provide an alphabetized list of districts that are either classified as urban or contain households that participated in re-interview surveys.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
शहरी वर्गीकृत जिलों या ऐसे जिलों की वर्णानुक्रमित सूची प्रदान करें जिनमें पुनः साक्षात्कार सर्वेक्षणों में भाग लेने वाले परिवार शामिल हैं।

english_question: List the IDs and member counts for households in rural Uttar Pradesh that are not classified as living below the poverty line.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
ग्रामीण उत्तर प्रदेश में उन परिवारों की आईडी और सदस्य संख्या सूचीबद्ध करें जो गरीबी रेखा से नीचे जीवन यापन करने वाले के रूप में वर्गीकृत नहीं हैं।

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the average monthly per capita consumption and the total number of households for families living above the poverty line, categorized by their 2001 urban or rural status.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर रहने वाले परिवारों के लिए, उनकी 2001 की शहरी या ग्रामीण स्थिति के आधार पर वर्गीकृत, औसत मासिक प्रति व्यक्ति खपत और परिवारों की कुल संख्या का राज्यवार विवरण प्रदान करें।

english_question: Compare the average monthly per capita consumption and total household count across different states and urban/rural areas, focusing only on households above the poverty line.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
विभिन्न राज्यों और शहरी/ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में औसत मासिक प्रति व्यक्ति खपत और कुल परिवारों की संख्या की तुलना करें, केवल गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर के परिवारों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हुए।

english_question: Identify the household IDs for all rural households that are currently living above the poverty line.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
उन सभी ग्रामीण परिवारों के घरेलू आईडी की पहचान करें जो वर्तमान में गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर रह रहे हैं।

english_question: Identify all rural households that are living above the poverty line, listed in ascending order by their ID.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर रहने वाले सभी ग्रामीण परिवारों की पहचान करें, जो उनके आईडी के अनुसार आरोही क्रम में सूचीबद्ध हों।

english_question: Identify the top 10 urban districts with the highest average monthly per capita consumption, including their respective poverty line thresholds.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
शीर्ष 10 शहरी जिलों की पहचान करें जिनकी औसत मासिक प्रति व्यक्ति खपत सबसे अधिक है, जिसमें उनकी संबंधित गरीबी रेखा सीमाएं भी शामिल हों।

english_question: Identify the top 10 urban districts with the highest average monthly per capita consumption, including their respective poverty lines.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
उन शीर्ष 10 शहरी जिलों की पहचान करें जिनकी औसत मासिक प्रति व्यक्ति खपत सबसे अधिक है, जिसमें उनकी संबंधित गरीबी रेखाएं शामिल हैं।

english_question: Identify districts where the average monthly per capita consumption is less than 500 despite being above the poverty line, and show the total number of children aged 0 to 14 in those areas.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
उन जिलों की पहचान करें जहां गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर होने के बावजूद औसत मासिक प्रति व्यक्ति खपत 500 से कम है, और उन क्षेत्रों में 0 से 14 वर्ष की आयु के बच्चों की कुल संख्या दिखाएं।

english_question: Identify rural districts and their states where the average monthly per capita consumption is below 996, ranked by the total number of children aged 0 to 14 living in households.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
उन ग्रामीण जिलों और उनके राज्यों की पहचान करें जहां औसत मासिक प्रति व्यक्ति खपत 996 से कम है, और उन्हें 0 से 14 वर्ष की आयु के बच्चों की कुल संख्या के आधार पर क्रमबद्ध किया गया हो।

english_question: Identify the rural districts that contain households living above the poverty line, excluding any urban districts that also have households above the poverty line.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर रहने वाले घरों वाले ग्रामीण जिलों की पहचान करें, उन शहरी जिलों को छोड़कर जिनमें गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर रहने वाले घर भी हैं।

english_question: List the states, in alphabetical order, that contain rural households where the number of residents aged 15 to 21 exceeds the number of children under 15.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
उन राज्यों की सूची बनाएं, वर्णानुक्रम में, जिनमें ग्रामीण परिवार ऐसे हैं जहां 15 से 21 वर्ष के निवासियों की संख्या 15 वर्ष से कम उम्र के बच्चों की संख्या से अधिक है।

english_question: Identify all states that contain at least one household where youth aged 15 to 21 outnumber children under 14, and also have at least one household living below the poverty line.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
उन सभी राज्यों की पहचान करें जहां कम से कम एक घर में 15 से 21 वर्ष के युवाओं की संख्या 14 वर्ष से कम उम्र के बच्चों से अधिक है, और साथ ही कम से कम एक घर गरीबी रेखा से नीचे जीवन यापन कर रहा है।

english_question: Identify all districts that contain households with either more than five children under the age of 15 or those living above the poverty line.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
उन सभी जिलों की पहचान करें जिनमें या तो 15 वर्ष से कम उम्र के पांच से अधिक बच्चों वाले परिवार हैं या गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर रहने वाले परिवार हैं।

english_question: Identify the districts that contain either households with more than five children under the age of 15 or households that are living above the poverty line.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
उन जिलों की पहचान करें जिनमें या तो 15 वर्ष से कम उम्र के पांच से अधिक बच्चों वाले घर हैं या गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर रहने वाले घर हैं।

english_question: Provide a breakdown by gender of the average years of education completed and the total number of individuals for all employed persons, ordered from highest to lowest average education level.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
सभी कार्यरत व्यक्तियों के लिए औसत शिक्षा वर्ष पूर्ण और व्यक्तियों की कुल संख्या का लिंग के अनुसार विवरण प्रदान करें, जिसे उच्चतम से निम्नतम औसत शिक्षा स्तर के क्रम में व्यवस्थित किया गया हो।

english_question: Identify individuals who have completed more than ten years of education but have never held a job.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
उन व्यक्तियों की पहचान करें जिन्होंने दस वर्ष से अधिक की शिक्षा पूरी की है लेकिन कभी नौकरी नहीं की है।

english_question: Identify the IDs of individuals who have completed more than ten years of education but have never held a job.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
उन व्यक्तियों के आईडी की पहचान करें जिन्होंने दस वर्ष से अधिक की शिक्षा पूरी की है लेकिन कभी नौकरी नहीं की है।

english_question: Identify the top 10 households with the highest number of youth aged 15 to 21, including their income source details.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
15 से 21 वर्ष की आयु के युवाओं की सबसे अधिक संख्या वाले शीर्ष 10 परिवारों की पहचान करें, जिसमें उनकी आय के स्रोत का विवरण भी शामिल हो।

english_question: Identify the IDs of individuals who have completed more than ten years of education but have never held a job.
translated_question:
इस प्रश्न का अनुवाद करें:
व्यक्तियों की पहचान करें जिन्होंने दस से अधिक वर्षों की शिक्षा पूरी की है लेकिन कभी काम नहीं किया है।

english_question: Identify the IDs of individuals who have completed more than ten years of education but have never held a job.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
उन व्यक्तियों की आईडी पहचानें जिन्होंने दस वर्ष से अधिक की शिक्षा पूरी की है लेकिन कभी नौकरी नहीं की है।

english_question: Identify the IDs of unemployed individuals who have completed more than ten years of education and have held exactly one job in the past, sorted by their ID.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
बेरोजगार व्यक्तियों के आईडी की पहचान करें जिन्होंने दस वर्ष से अधिक की शिक्षा पूरी की है और अतीत में ठीक एक नौकरी रख चुके हैं, उनके आईडी के अनुसार क्रमबद्ध किया गया।

english_question: Identify individuals living in large households of more than six members who have completed at least 15 years of education and have held at least one job, ordered by the size of their household.
translated_question:
इस क्वेरी का अनुवाद करें:
छह से अधिक सदस्यों वाले बड़े परिवारों में रहने वाले उन व्यक्तियों की पहचान करें, जिन्होंने कम से कम 15 वर्ष की शिक्षा पूरी की है और कम से कम एक नौकरी की है, उनके परिवार के आकार के अनुसार क्रमबद्ध करें।

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 14 and under.
translated_question:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
१४ वर्षांखालील तीनपेक्षा जास्त मुले असलेले सर्व शहरी कुटुंब ओळखा.

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 0 to 14, listed in ascending order of their household ID.
translated_question:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
शहरी कुटुंबांमध्ये, ज्यांचे ० ते १४ वयोगटातील तीनपेक्षा जास्त मुले आहेत, अशी सर्व कुटुंबे ओळखा आणि त्यांच्या कुटुंब आयडीच्या चढत्या क्रमाने सूचीबद्ध करा.

english_question: Identify the top 10 rural districts with the highest average household member counts, specifically focusing on those within the second neighborhood category.
translated_question:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
दुसऱ्या शेजारी श्रेणीतील ग्रामीण जिल्ह्यांमध्ये सर्वाधिक सरासरी घरगुती सदस्य संख्या असलेल्या शीर्ष 10 ग्रामीण जिल्ह्यांची ओळख करा.

english_question: Provide a breakdown by state of the total number of household members and married women living in urban areas.
translated_question:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
शहरी भागातील एकूण घरगुती सदस्य आणि विवाहित महिलांची राज्यनिहाय विभागणी द्या.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the total number of household members and married women living in urban areas, ordered alphabetically by state.
translated_question:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
शहरी भागातील एकूण कुटुंबातील सदस्य आणि विवाहित महिलांचे राज्यनिहाय विभाजन, राज्यांच्या वर्णक्रमानुसार क्रमवारीत प्रदान करा.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the total number of household members and married women living in urban areas, focusing only on states with more than five household members and sorting the results by the highest count of married women.
translated_question:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
शहरी भागातील एकूण घरगुती सदस्य आणि विवाहित महिलांची राज्यनिहाय विभागणी प्रदान करा, फक्त पाचपेक्षा जास्त घरगुती सदस्य असलेल्या राज्यांवर लक्ष केंद्रित करून आणि विवाहित महिलांच्या सर्वोच्च संख्येनुसार निकालांची क्रमवारी लावा.

english_question: Identify the geographic areas that included at least three youths aged 15 to 21 per household, specifically focusing on data collected from re-interviewed households.

english_question: Identify the states and districts that are either classified as urban areas or contain households with more than three young residents aged 15 to 21.
translated_question:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
शहरी क्षेत्र म्हणून वर्गीकृत केलेले किंवा १५ ते २१ वयोगटातील तीनहून अधिक तरुण रहिवाशांची घरे असलेले राज्ये आणि जिल्हे ओळखा.

english_question: List the states and districts that are either classified as urban or have more than three residents aged 15 to 21, sorted by state and district name.
translated_question:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
शहरी वर्गीकृत असलेल्या किंवा १५ ते २१ वयोगटातील तीनपेक्षा जास्त रहिवासी असलेल्या राज्ये आणि जिल्हे यांची यादी करा, राज्य आणि जिल्ह्याच्या नावानुसार क्रमवारी लावा.

english_question: List the household IDs and their corresponding asset indices for Dalit households located in rural areas of Uttar Pradesh, ordered by their asset index.

english_question: Provide the household IDs and asset indices for Dalit households in rural Uttar Pradesh, ordered from lowest to highest asset index.
translated_question:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
ग्रामीण उत्तर प्रदेशातील दलित घरांसाठी घरांची आयडी आणि मालमत्ता निर्देशांक सादर करा, जे कमीत कमी ते उच्च मालमत्ता निर्देशांकानुसार क्रमवारीत असतील.

english_question: Provide a breakdown of the average household size and the average number of married women per household, categorized by religious or caste groups, urban-rural status, and state.

english_question: Rank the states by the average number of children aged 0 to 14 per household, from highest to lowest.

english_question: Rank the states by the average number of children aged 0 to 14 per household, including only those states with more than one recorded household.

english_question: Identify the top 5 rural districts in Uttar Pradesh with the highest average household size, considering only those districts with more than one recorded household.

english_question: List the states that have Dalit households categorized in the 15th asset index, sorted alphabetically.
translated_question:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
१५ व्या मालमत्ता निर्देशांकात वर्गीकृत असलेल्या दलित कुटुंबांच्या राज्यांची यादी वर्णक्रमानुसार द्या.

english_question: Which states contain at least one district with Dalit households and also report households with an asset index of 15?

english_question: Provide a breakdown by state and urban/rural status showing the average number of married women and the total number of children aged 0 to 14 per household.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the average number of married women and the total number of children under 15 per household, categorized by urban and rural areas.
translated_question:

शहरी आणि ग्रामीण भागांनुसार वर्गीकृत, प्रत्येक राज्यातील सरासरी लग्न झालेल्या महिलांची संख्या आणि १५ वर्षाखालील मुलांची एकूण संख्या प्रति कुटुंब द्या.

english_question: Provide a breakdown by state and urban/rural status showing the average number of married women and the total number of children under 15 per household, focusing only on areas where households average more than one married woman and ranking the results by the highest child population.

या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the average monthly per capita consumption and the total number of households for families living above the poverty line, categorized by their 2001 urban or rural status.

english_question: Compare the average monthly per capita consumption and total household count across different states and urban/rural areas, focusing only on households above the poverty line.

english_question: Identify rural districts and their states where the average monthly per capita consumption is below 996, ranked by the total number of children aged 0 to 14 living in households.

अशा सर्व जिल्ह्यांची ओळख करा ज्यात किंवा पाचपेक्षा जास्त १५ वर्षाखालील मुले असलेली कुटुंबे आहेत किंवा जी गरिबीरेषेच्या वर राहतात.

english_question: Identify the IDs of individuals who have completed more than ten years of education but have never held a job.

english_question: Identify the IDs of individuals who have completed more than ten years of education but are currently unemployed, ordered by their level of education from highest to lowest.
translated_question:

दहा वर्षांपेक्षा जास्त शिक्षण पूर्ण केलेल्या परंतु सध्या बेरोजगार असलेल्या व्यक्तींची ओळख क्रमांक ओळखा, त्यांच्या शिक्षणाच्या पातळीनुसार उच्चतम ते निम्नतम क्रमाने मांडा.

english_question: Rank the households by the average number of years of education completed by their adult members aged 21 and older.

english_question: Identify the top 10 households with the highest number of youth aged 15 to 21, including their income source details.
translated_question:
या प्रश्नाचे मराठीत भाषांतर करा:
१५ ते २१ वयोगटातील तरुणांची संख्या सर्वात जास्त असलेल्या शीर्ष १० कुटुंबांची ओळख करा, त्यांच्या उत्पन्नाच्या स्रोतांच्या तपशीलासह.

english_question: Identify the IDs of individuals who have completed more than ten years of education but have never held a job.

दहा वर्षांपेक्षा जास्त शिक्षण पूर्ण केलेल्या परंतु कधीही नोकरी केलेली नसलेल्या व्यक्तींची ओळख (ID) शोधा.

english_question: Identify the IDs of individuals who have completed more than ten years of education but have never held a job.
translated_question:

दहा वर्षांपेक्षा जास्त शिक्षण पूर्ण केलेल्या परंतु कधीही नोकरी केलेली नसलेल्या व्यक्तींची ओळख क्रमांक ओळखा.

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 14 and under.
translated_question:

14 வயது மற்றும் அதற்கும் குறைவான வயதுடன் மூன்று குழந்தைகளுக்கு மேல் உள்ள அனைத்து நகர்புற குடும்பங்களையும் கண்டறியவும்.

english_question: Identify the top 10 rural districts with the highest average household member counts, specifically focusing on those within the second neighborhood category.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
இரண்டாவது அண்டை வகைப்பாட்டில் உள்ள, அதிக சராசரி குடும்ப உறுப்பினர் எண்ணிக்கை கொண்ட முதல் 10 கிராமப்புற மாவட்டங்களை அடையாளம் காணவும்.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the total number of household members and married women living in urban areas, focusing only on states with more than five household members and sorting the results by the highest count of married women.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
நகர்ப்புறங்களில் வசிக்கும் மொத்த குடும்ப உறுப்பினர்கள் மற்றும் திருமணமான பெண்களின் மாநில வாரியான பிரிவினையை வழங்கவும், ஐந்துக்கும் மேற்பட்ட குடும்ப உறுப்பினர்கள் உள்ள மாநிலங்களில் மட்டும் கவனம் செலுத்தி, முடிவுகளை திருமணமான பெண்களின் அதிக எண்ணிக்கையின்படி வரிசைப்படுத்தவும்.

english_question: Identify the IDs of geographic areas where there is at least one re-interviewed household containing three or more youths aged 15 to 21, sorted numerically.
translated_question:
பின்வரும் வினவலைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:

english_question: Identify the states and districts that are either classified as urban or contain households with more than three residents aged 15 to 21.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:

english_question: Identify the states and districts that are either classified as urban areas or contain households with more than three young residents aged 15 to 21.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
நகர்ப்புறப் பகுதிகளாக வகைப்படுத்தப்பட்டுள்ள அல்லது 15 முதல் 21 வயது வரையிலான மூன்றுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட இளம் குடியிருப்பாளர்களைக் கொண்ட குடும்பங்களைக் கொண்ட மாநிலங்களையும் மாவட்டங்களையும் அடையாளம் காணவும்.

english_question: List the household IDs and their corresponding asset indices for Dalit households located in rural areas of Uttar Pradesh, ordered by their asset index.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
உத்தரப் பிரதேசத்தின் கிராமப்புறங்களில் உள்ள தலித் குடும்பங்களின் வீட்டு அடையாளங்களையும், அவற்றின் தொடர்புடைய சொத்து குறியீடுகளையும், அவற்றின் சொத்து குறியீட்டின் படி வரிசைப்படுத்தி பட்டியலிடுங்கள்.

english_question: Identify all rural households that have more than three children aged 14 or younger, listed in ascending order of their ID.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
14 வயதுக்குட்பட்ட மூன்றுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட குழந்தைகள் உள்ள அனைத்து கிராமப்புற குடும்பங்களையும், அவற்றின் அடையாள எண்ணின் ஏறுவரிசையில் பட்டியலிடுங்கள்.

english_question: Identify the top 5 rural districts in Uttar Pradesh with the highest average household size, considering only those districts with more than one recorded household.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
ஒன்றுக்கு மேற்பட்ட பதிவுசெய்யப்பட்ட குடும்பங்கள் உள்ள மாவட்டங்களை மட்டும் கருத்தில் கொண்டு, உத்தரப் பிரதேசத்தில் அதிக சராசரி குடும்ப அளவைக் கொண்ட முதல் 5 கிராமப்புற மாவட்டங்களை அடையாளம் காணவும்.

english_question: Which districts in Rajasthan have no households belonging to the Dalit caste group among those with a household assets index of 15?
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
இராஜஸ்தானில் எந்த மாவட்டங்களில் 15 என்ற குடும்ப சொத்துக் குறியீட்டைக் கொண்ட குடும்பங்களில் தலித் சாதி குழுவைச் சேர்ந்த குடும்பங்கள் இல்லை?

english_question: Identify the states and districts that contain households either belonging to the Brahmin group or ranking 21 on the household assets index, sorted alphabetically by state.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
பிராமணர் குழுவைச் சேர்ந்தவை அல்லது குடும்ப சொத்துக்குறியீட்டில் 21 வது இடத்தைப் பெற்ற குடும்பங்களைக் கொண்ட மாநிலங்களையும் மாவட்டங்களையும் அடையாளம் காணவும், மாநிலத்தின் அகர வரிசைப்படி வரிசைப்படுத்தவும்.

english_question: Identify the states and districts that contain at least one household belonging to the Brahmin group or those ranked at a 21 on the household assets index, sorted alphabetically by state.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
பிராமண குழுவைச் சேர்ந்த குறைந்தபட்சம் ஒரு குடும்பமாவது உள்ள மாநிலங்களையும் மாவட்டங்களையும் அல்லது வீட்டு சொத்து குறியீட்டில் 21 வது இடத்தில் உள்ளவர்களையும் அடையாளம் காணவும், மாநிலங்களின் அகர வரிசையில் வரிசைப்படுத்தவும்.

english_question: Identify the household IDs and corresponding village or neighborhood codes for rural households in Rajasthan that have more than two married women.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
ராஜஸ்தானில் இரண்டுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட திருமணமான பெண்களைக் கொண்ட கிராமப்புற குடும்பங்களின் வீட்டு அடையாளங்களையும், அதற்குரிய கிராம அல்லது அண்டை குறியீடுகளையும் அடையாளம் காணவும்.

english_question: Identify rural households in Himachal Pradesh that have more than two married women, providing their household IDs and local neighborhood or village codes.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
இமாச்சலப் பிரதேசத்தில் இரண்டுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட திருமணமான பெண்களைக் கொண்ட கிராமப்புற குடும்பங்களை அடையாளம் காணவும், அவற்றின் குடும்ப அடையாளங்கள் மற்றும் உள்ளூர் அருகாமை அல்லது கிராமக் குறியீடுகளை வழங்கவும்.

english_question: Identify the household IDs and their corresponding village or neighborhood codes for rural households in Himachal Pradesh that have more than two married women.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
இமாச்சலப் பிரதேசத்தில் இரண்டுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட திருமணமான பெண்கள் உள்ள கிராமப்புற குடும்பங்களின் வீட்டு அடையாளங்களையும், அவற்றுடன் தொடர்புடைய கிராம அல்லது அண்டைப் பகுதிக் குறியீடுகளையும் அடையாளம் காணவும்.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the average number of married women and the total number of children under 15 per household, categorized by urban and rural areas.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
நகர்ப்புற மற்றும் கிராமப்புற பகுதிகளாக வகைப்படுத்தப்பட்ட, ஒவ்வொரு மாநிலத்தின் வீட்டிற்கு சராசரி திருமணமான பெண்களின் எண்ணிக்கை மற்றும் 15 வயதுக்குட்பட்ட குழந்தைகளின் மொத்த எண்ணிக்கையை மாநில வாரியாக வழங்கவும்.

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 14 and under.
translated_question:
இந்த கேள்வியை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
14 வயது மற்றும் அதற்கும் குறைவான வயதில் மூன்று குழந்தைகளுக்கு மேல் உள்ள அனைத்து நகர்ப்புற குடும்பங்களையும் கண்டறியவும்.

english_question: Identify the top 5 rural districts with the highest average number of married women per household, considering only those districts with more than one household record.
translated_question:
மேலேயுள்ள வினாவைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
ஒன்றுக்கு மேற்பட்ட வீட்டு வரலாற்று பதிவுகளைக் கொண்ட மாவட்டங்களை மட்டும் கருத்தில் கொண்டு, ஒரு வீட்டிற்கு சராசரியாக அதிக எண்ணிக்கையிலான திருமணமான பெண்களைக் கொண்ட முதல் 5 கிராமப்புற மாவட்டங்களை அடையாளம் காணவும்.

english_question: List the IDs and member counts for households in rural Uttar Pradesh that are not classified as living below the poverty line.
translated_question:
கீழ்வரும் வினவலைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
கிராமப்புற உத்தரப்பிரதேசத்தில் வறுமைக் கோட்டுக்குக் கீழ் வாழ்வதாக வகைப்படுத்தப்படாத குடும்பங்களின் அடையாள எண்கள் மற்றும் உறுப்பினர் எண்ணிக்கைகளை பட்டியலிடுங்கள்.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the average monthly per capita consumption and the total number of households for families living above the poverty line, categorized by their 2001 urban or rural status.
translated_question:

english_question: Identify rural districts and their states where the average monthly per capita consumption is below 996, ranked by the total number of children aged 0 to 14 living in households.
translated_question:
கீழ்க்கண்ட வினாவை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
மாதாந்திர தனிநபர் நுகர்வு சராசரி 996 க்கும் குறைவாக உள்ள கிராமப்புற மாவட்டங்களையும் அவற்றின் மாநிலங்களையும் அடையாளம் காணவும், மேலும் 0 முதல் 14 வயது வரையிலான குழந்தைகளின் மொத்த எண்ணிக்கையின்படி வரிசைப்படுத்தவும்.

english_question: Identify all states that contain at least one household where youth aged 15 to 21 outnumber children under 14, and also have at least one household living below the poverty line.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலைத் தமிழில் மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
அனைத்து மாநிலங்களையும் அடையாளம் காணவும், அங்கு 15 முதல் 21 வயதுடைய இளைஞர்களின் எண்ணிக்கை 14 வயதுக்குட்பட்ட குழந்தைகளை விட அதிகமாக உள்ள குறைந்தது ஒரு வீட்டு வசதி உள்ளது, மேலும் வறுமைக் கோட்டிற்குக் கீழே வாழும் குறைந்தது ஒரு வீட்டு வசதியும் உள்ளது.

english_question: Identify all districts that contain households with either more than five children under the age of 15 or those living above the poverty line.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
ஐந்துக்கும் மேற்பட்ட 15 வயதுக்குட்பட்ட குழந்தைகள் உள்ள குடும்பங்கள் அல்லது வறுமைக் கோட்டிற்கு மேல் வாழும் குடும்பங்கள் உள்ள அனைத்து மாவட்டங்களையும் அடையாளம் காணவும்.

english_question: Identify all individuals who have held at least one job and have experience working either on a family farm or in animal care, listed by their person ID.
translated_question:
இந்த வினவலை மொழிபெயர்க்கவும்:
குறைந்தபட்சம் ஒரு வேலையை வைத்திருந்த மற்றும் குடும்ப பண்ணையில் அல்லது விலங்கு பராமரிப்பில் பணிபுரிந்த அனுபவம் உள்ள அனைத்து நபர்களையும், அவர்களின் நபர் ஐடி மூலம் பட்டியலிடுங்கள்.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the average household size and total number of households, categorized by urban and rural areas according to the 2001 Census.
translated_question:

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 14 and under.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:

english_question: Identify urban households that have more than three children between the ages of 0 and 14.
translated_question:

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 0 to 14, listed in ascending order of their household ID.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the total number of household members and married women living in urban areas, focusing only on states with more than five household members and sorting the results by the highest count of married women.

english_question: Identify the geography IDs for households that contain at least three youths aged 15 to 21 and were part of a re-interview survey.
translated_question:

english_question: Identify the geographic areas that included at least three youths aged 15 to 21 per household, specifically focusing on data collected from re-interviewed households.

english_question: Identify the IDs of geographic areas where there is at least one re-interviewed household containing three or more youths aged 15 to 21, sorted numerically.

english_question: Identify the states and districts that are either classified as urban or contain households with more than three residents aged 15 to 21.
translated_question:

english_question: Identify the states and districts that are either classified as urban areas or contain households with more than three young residents aged 15 to 21.

english_question: List the states and districts that are either classified as urban or have more than three residents aged 15 to 21, sorted by state and district name.

english_question: Identify the top 5 rural districts in Uttar Pradesh with the highest average household size, considering only those districts with more than one recorded household.

english_question: Identify the states and districts that contain at least one household belonging to the Brahmin group or those ranked at a 21 on the household assets index, sorted alphabetically by state.

english_question: Provide the total number of married women and children aged 0 to 14 living in urban areas, specifically for regions with more than one recorded household.

ఒకటి కంటే ఎక్కువ నమోదైన గృహాలు ఉన్న ప్రాంతాలకు ముఖ్యంగా పట్టణ ప్రాంతాల్లో నివసిస్తున్న వివాహిత మహిళలు మరియు 0 నుండి 14 సంవత్సరాల వయస్సు గల పిల్లల మొత్తం సంఖ్యను అందించండి.

english_question: Identify the urban districts where no households were selected for a re-interview during the survey.

english_question: Identify the urban districts where no households were selected for a re-interview during the survey.
translated_question:

english_question: Identify all urban districts where no household surveys were conducted via re-interviews, listed in alphabetical order.
translated_question:

పునః ఇంటర్వ్యూలు ద్వారా ఏ గృహ సర్వేలు నిర్వహించబడని అన్ని పట్టణ జిల్లాలను గుర్తించండి, వాటిని అక్షర క్రమంలో జాబితా చేయండి.

english_question: Identify the urban districts that have at least one household with a married woman.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ఒక వివాహిత మహిళ ఉన్న కనీసం ఒక గృహం ఉన్న పట్టణ జిల్లాలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify all districts that either are classified as urban areas or have conducted household re-interviews.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
అన్ని జిల్లాలను గుర్తించండి, అవి పట్టణ ప్రాంతాలుగా వర్గీకరించబడినవి లేదా గృహ పునః ఇంటర్వ్యూలు నిర్వహించినవి.

english_question: Provide an alphabetized list of districts that are either classified as urban or contain households that participated in re-interview surveys.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
పట్టణంగా వర్గీకరించబడిన లేదా తిరిగి ఇంటర్వ్యూ సర్వేలలో పాల్గొన్న కుటుంబాలను కలిగి ఉన్న జిల్లాల యొక్క అక్షర క్రమ జాబితాను అందించండి.

english_question: List the names of urban districts or those containing re-interviewed households, sorted alphabetically.

పట్టణ జిల్లాలు లేదా తిరిగి ఇంటర్వ్యూ చేయబడిన కుటుంబాలను కలిగి ఉన్న జిల్లాల పేర్లను అక్షర క్రమంలో జాబితా చేయండి.

english_question: List the IDs and member counts for households in rural Uttar Pradesh that are not classified as living below the poverty line.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
గ్రామీణ ఉత్తర ప్రదేశ్లో పేదరేఖకు దిగువన లేని గృహాల IDలు మరియు సభ్యుల సంఖ్యను జాబితా చేయండి.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the average monthly per capita consumption and the total number of households for families living above the poverty line, categorized by their 2001 urban or rural status.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ప్రతి రాష్ట్రానికి, 2001 సంవత్సరం నగరా లేదా గ్రామీణ స్థితి ప్రకారం వర్గీకరించబడిన, పేదరికం రేఖకు పైన ఉన్న కుటుంబాలకు సగటు నెలవారీ వ్యక్తిగత వినియోగం మరియు మొత్తం గృహాల సంఖ్య వివరణను అందించండి.

english_question: Identify the household IDs for all rural households that are currently living above the poverty line.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ప్రస్తుతం పేదరేఖకు పైన జీవిస్తున్న అన్ని గ్రామీణ గృహాల గృహ ID లను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify all rural households that are living above the poverty line, listed in ascending order by their ID.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
దారిద్య్ర రేఖకు పైన నివసిస్తున్న అన్ని గ్రామీణ గృహాలను గుర్తించండి, వాటి ID ఆధారంగా ఆరోహణ క్రమంలో జాబితా చేయండి.

english_question: Rank the states by their average monthly per capita consumption for households that are above the poverty line.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
దారిద్య్ర రేఖకు పైన ఉన్న గృహాల సగటు నెలవారీ తలసరి వినియోగం ఆధారంగా రాష్ట్రాలను ర్యాంక్ చేయండి.

english_question: Identify the top 10 urban districts with the highest average monthly per capita consumption, including their respective poverty line thresholds.

english_question: Identify the top 10 urban districts with the highest average monthly per capita consumption, including their respective poverty lines.

english_question: Identify the top 10 urban districts with the highest average monthly per capita consumption, including their respective poverty lines.
translated_question:

గరిష్ఠ సగటు నెలవారీ తలసరి వినియోగం ఉన్న అగ్ర 10 పట్టణ జిల్లాలను గుర్తించండి, వాటి సంబంధిత దారిద్య్ర రేఖలతో సహా.

english_question: Identify districts where the average monthly per capita consumption is less than 500 despite being above the poverty line, and show the total number of children aged 0 to 14 in those areas.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
దారిద్య్ర రేఖకు పైన ఉన్నప్పటికీ, సగటు నెలసరి తలసరి వినియోగం 500 కంటే తక్కువ ఉన్న జిల్లాలను గుర్తించండి మరియు ఆ ప్రాంతాలలో 0 నుండి 14 సంవత్సరాల వయస్సు గల మొత్తం పిల్లల సంఖ్యను చూపించండి.

english_question: Identify rural districts and their states where the average monthly per capita consumption is below 996, ranked by the total number of children aged 0 to 14 living in households.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
సగటు నెలసరి తలసరి వినియోగం 996 కంటే తక్కువ ఉన్న గ్రామీణ జిల్లాలు మరియు వాటి రాష్ట్రాలను గుర్తించండి, మరియు 0 నుండి 14 సంవత్సరాల వయస్సు గల పిల్లల మొత్తం సంఖ్య ఆధారంగా ర్యాంక్ చేయండి.

english_question: Identify the districts that contain rural households living above the poverty line, but do not have any urban households above the poverty line.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
పేదరిక రేఖకు పైన నివసించే గ్రామీణ కుటుంబాలు ఉన్న, కానీ పేదరిక రేఖకు పైన నివసించే ఏ ఊరు కుటుంబాలు లేని జిల్లాలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the rural districts that contain households living above the poverty line, excluding any urban districts that also have households above the poverty line.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
గరిష్ఠ పేదరిక రేఖకు పైన జీవిస్తున్న గృహాలను కలిగి ఉన్న గ్రామీణ జిల్లాలను గుర్తించండి, అదే విధంగా గరిష్ఠ పేదరిక రేఖకు పైన జీవిస్తున్న గృహాలను కలిగి ఉన్న పట్టణ జిల్లాలను మినహాయించండి.

english_question: List the states, in alphabetical order, that contain rural households where the number of residents aged 15 to 21 exceeds the number of children under 15.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
రాష్ట్రాలను అక్షర క్రమంలో జాబితా చేయండి, ఇందులో 15 నుండి 21 సంవత్సరాల వయస్సు గల నివాసుల సంఖ్య 15 సంవత్సరాల కంటే తక్కువ వయస్సు గల పిల్లల సంఖ్యను మించిన గ్రామీణ గృహాలు ఉన్నాయి.

english_question: Identify all states that contain at least one household where youth aged 15 to 21 outnumber children under 14, and also have at least one household living below the poverty line.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను అనువదించండి:
అన్ని రాష్ట్రాలను గుర్తించండి, అవి కనీసం ఒక కుటుంబాన్ని కలిగి ఉండాలి, అందులో 15 నుండి 21 సంవత్సరాల వయస్సు గల యువత 14 సంవత్సరాల కంటే తక్కువ వయస్సు గల పిల్లల కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉండాలి, మరియు కనీసం ఒక కుటుంబం పేదరిక రేఖ క్రింద జీవిస్తున్నట్లు కూడా ఉండాలి.

english_question: Identify all districts that contain households with either more than five children under the age of 15 or those living above the poverty line.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
15 సంవత్సరాల కంటే తక్కువ వయస్సు గల ఐదు కంటే ఎక్కువ పిల్లలు ఉన్న కుటుంబాలు లేదా పేదరేఖకు పైన జీవించే కుటుంబాలు ఉన్న అన్ని జిల్లాలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the districts that contain either households with more than five children under the age of 15 or households that are living above the poverty line.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ఐదు కంటే ఎక్కువ పిల్లలు (15 సంవత్సరాల కంటే తక్కువ వయస్సు) ఉన్న కుటుంబాలు లేదా దారిద్ర్య రేఖకు పైన జీవించే కుటుంబాలు ఉన్న జిల్లాలను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Provide a breakdown by gender of the average years of education completed and the total number of individuals for all employed persons, ordered from highest to lowest average education level.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
ఉపాధి పొందిన వ్యక్తులందరికీ, లింగం ఆధారంగా సగటు విద్యా సంవత్సరాల వివరణ మరియు మొత్తం వ్యక్తుల సంఖ్యను అందించండి, ఇది అత్యధిక సగటు విద్యా స్థాయి నుండి అత్యల్ప స్థాయికి క్రమబద్ధీకరించబడాలి.

english_question: Identify the IDs of individuals who have completed more than ten years of education but are currently unemployed, ordered by their level of education from highest to lowest.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
పది సంవత్సరాల కంటే ఎక్కువ విద్యను పూర్తి చేసిన, కానీ ప్రస్తుతం నిరుద్యోగంలో ఉన్న వ్యక్తుల ID లను గుర్తించండి, వారి విద్యా స్థాయి ప్రకారం అత్యధికం నుండి తక్కువ వరకు క్రమబద్ధీకరించండి.

english_question: Rank the households by the average number of years of education completed by their adult members aged 21 and older.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
21 సంవత్సరాలు మరియు అంతకంటే ఎక్కువ వయస్సు గల వయోజన సభ్యుల పూర్తి చేసిన విద్యా సంవత్సరాల సగటు సంఖ్య ఆధారంగా కుటుంబాలను ర్యాంక్ చేయండి.

english_question: Identify the top 10 households with the highest number of youth aged 15 to 21, including their income source details.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
15 నుండి 21 సంవత్సరాల వయస్సు గల యువతల సంఖ్య ఎక్కువగా ఉన్న టాప్ 10 కుటుంబాలను గుర్తించండి, వారి ఆదాయ వనరుల వివరాలతో సహా.

english_question: Identify the top 10 households with the highest number of residents aged 15 to 21, including their total youth counts, based on available income and poverty data.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను అనువదించండి:
అందుబాటులో ఉన్న ఆదాయం మరియు పేదరికం డేటా ఆధారంగా, 15 నుండి 21 సంవత్సరాల వయస్సు గల నివాసితుల సంఖ్య అత్యధికంగా ఉన్న టాప్ 10 గృహాలను, వాటి మొత్తం యువత గణనలతో సహా గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify the IDs of individuals who have completed more than ten years of education but have never held a job.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
పది సంవత్సరాల కంటే ఎక్కువ విద్యను పూర్తి చేసిన వ్యక్తుల ID లను గుర్తించండి, కానీ ఎప్పుడూ ఉద్యోగం చేయని వారిని.

english_question: Identify the IDs of unemployed individuals who have completed more than ten years of education and have held exactly one job in the past, sorted by their ID.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులో అనువదించండి:
పది సంవత్సరాల కంటే ఎక్కువ విద్యను పూర్తి చేసిన మరియు గతంలో ఖచ్చితంగా ఒక ఉద్యోగాన్ని కలిగి ఉన్న నిరుద్యోగుల ID లను గుర్తించండి, వారి ID ద్వారా క్రమబద్ధీకరించబడింది.

english_question: Identify all individuals who have experience working either on a family farm or in animal care.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను తెలుగులోకి అనువదించండి:
కుటుంబ వ్యవసాయంలో లేదా జంతు సంరక్షణలో అనుభవం ఉన్న అందరు వ్యక్తులను గుర్తించండి.

english_question: Identify all individuals who have held at least one job and have experience working either on a family farm or in animal care, listed by their person ID.
translated_question:
ఈ ప్రశ్నను అనువదించండి:
కనీసం ఒక ఉద్యోగం చేసిన మరియు కుటుంబ వ్యవసాయంలో లేదా జంతు సంరక్షణలో పని అనుభవం ఉన్న అన్ని వ్యక్తులను వారి వ్యక్తి ఐడీ ద్వారా జాబితా చేయండి.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the total number of household members and married women living in urban areas, focusing only on states with more than five household members and sorting the results by the highest count of married women.
translated_question:
এই অনুরোধটি অনুবাদ করুন:
শহুরে এলাকায় বসবাসকারী মোট পরিবারের সদস্য এবং বিবাহিত নারীদের সংখ্যার একটি রাজ্যভিত্তিক বিশ্লেষণ প্রদান করুন, শুধুমাত্র সেই রাজ্যগুলির উপর ফোকাস করুন যেখানে পাঁচের বেশি পরিবারের সদস্য রয়েছে এবং ফলাফলগুলি বিবাহিত নারীদের সর্বোচ্চ সংখ্যা অনুসারে সাজান।

english_question: Identify the geography IDs for households that contain at least three youths aged 15 to 21 and were part of a re-interview survey.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
যেসব পরিবারে অন্তত তিনজন ১৫ থেকে ২১ বছর বয়সী যুবক রয়েছে এবং যারা পুনরায় জরিপের অংশ ছিল, তাদের ভূগোল আইডি চিহ্নিত করুন।

english_question: Identify the states and districts that are either classified as urban or contain households with more than three residents aged 15 to 21.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
যেসব রাজ্য এবং জেলা শহুরে শ্রেণীতে অন্তর্ভুক্ত বা যাদের পরিবারে ১৫ থেকে ২১ বছর বয়সী তিনজন以上的 বাসিন্দা আছে, তাদের চিহ্নিত করুন।

english_question: Identify the states and districts that are either classified as urban areas or contain households with more than three young residents aged 15 to 21.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
যে রাজ্য এবং জেলাগুলি হয় শহুরে এলাকা হিসেবে শ্রেণীবদ্ধ করা হয়েছে বা যেগুলিতে ১৫ থেকে ২১ বছর বয়সী তিনজনের বেশি তরুণ বাসিন্দা রয়েছে এমন পরিবার রয়েছে সেগুলি চিহ্নিত করুন।

english_question: List the states and districts that are either classified as urban or have more than three residents aged 15 to 21, sorted by state and district name.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
যে রাজ্য এবং জেলাগুলো হয় শহুরে শ্রেণিভুক্ত অথবা যেখানে ১৫ থেকে ২১ বছর বয়সী তিনজনের বেশি বাসিন্দা রয়েছে, তাদের রাজ্য এবং জেলার নাম অনুসারে বর্ণানুক্রমিকভাবে তালিকা করুন।

english_question: List the household IDs and their corresponding asset indices for Dalit households located in rural areas of Uttar Pradesh, ordered by their asset index.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
উত্তর প্রদেশের গ্রামীণ এলাকায় অবস্থিত দলিত পরিবারের জন্য পরিবারের আইডি এবং তাদের সংশ্লিষ্ট সম্পদ সূচক তালিকাভুক্ত করুন, তাদের সম্পদ সূচক অনুসারে ক্রমান্বয়ে সাজিয়ে।

english_question: Provide the household IDs and asset indices for Dalit households in rural Uttar Pradesh, ordered from lowest to highest asset index.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
উত্তর প্রদান করুন: গ্রামীণ উত্তরপ্রদেশের দলিত পরিবারের জন্য পরিবারের আইডি এবং সম্পদ সূচকগুলি, সর্বনিম্ন থেকে সর্বোচ্চ সম্পদ সূচক অনুসারে ক্রমান্বয়ে।

english_question: Provide the average household size and the average number of married women per household, broken down by caste/religion group and urban or rural classification.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
জাতি/ধর্মীয় গোষ্ঠী এবং শহুরে বা গ্রামীণ শ্রেণীবিভাগ অনুযায়ী গৃহস্থালির গড় আকার এবং প্রতি পরিবারে বিবাহিত মহিলাদের গড় সংখ্যা প্রদান করুন।

english_question: Identify all rural households that have more than three children aged 14 and under.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
সব গ্রামীণ পরিবার চিহ্নিত করুন যাদের ১৪ বছর বা তার কম বয়সী তিনটির বেশি সন্তান রয়েছে।

english_question: Identify all rural households that have more than three children aged 14 or younger, listed in ascending order of their ID.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
সব গ্রামীণ পরিবার চিহ্নিত করুন যাদের তিনের বেশি শিশু রয়েছে যাদের বয়স ১৪ বা তার কম, তাদের আইডি অনুসারে ঊর্ধ্বক্রমে তালিকাভুক্ত করুন।

english_question: Identify the top five districts in rural Uttar Pradesh with the highest average household size.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
গ্রামীণ উত্তর প্রদেশের শীর্ষ পাঁচটি জেলা চিহ্নিত করুন যেখানে গড় পরিবারের আকার সর্বোচ্চ।

english_question: Identify the top 5 rural districts in Uttar Pradesh with the highest average household size, considering only those districts with more than one recorded household.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
উত্তর প্রদেশের শীর্ষ ৫টি গ্রামীণ জেলা চিহ্নিত করুন যাদের গড় পরিবারের আকার সর্বাধিক, শুধুমাত্র সেইসব জেলাগুলো বিবেচনা করে যেখানে একাধিক নথিভুক্ত পরিবার রয়েছে।

english_question: Identify the states and districts that contain households either belonging to the Brahmin group or ranking 21 on the household assets index, sorted alphabetically by state.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
যে রাজ্য এবং জেলাগুলিতে ব্রাহ্মণ গোষ্ঠীর অন্তর্ভুক্ত পরিবার রয়েছে অথবা পরিবারের সম্পদ সূচকে ২১তম স্থানে রয়েছে, তাদের রাজ্যের বর্ণানুক্রমে সাজিয়ে চিহ্নিত করুন।

english_question: Identify the states and districts that contain at least one household belonging to the Brahmin group or those ranked at a 21 on the household assets index, sorted alphabetically by state.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
যে রাজ্য এবং জেলাগুলিতে অন্তত একটি পরিবার ব্রাহ্মণ গোষ্ঠীর অন্তর্ভুক্ত অথবা যাদের পরিবারের সম্পদ সূচকে ২১ র্যাঙ্কিং রয়েছে, তাদের রাজ্যের বর্ণানুক্রমে সাজিয়ে চিহ্নিত করুন।

english_question: Identify the household IDs and corresponding village or neighborhood codes for rural households in Rajasthan that have more than two married women.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
রাজস্থানের গ্রামীণ পরিবারগুলির জন্য পরিবারের আইডি এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট গ্রাম বা পাড়ার কোড চিহ্নিত করুন যেখানে দুই জনের বেশি বিবাহিত মহিলা আছেন।

english_question: Identify the household IDs and their corresponding village or neighborhood codes for rural households in Himachal Pradesh that have more than two married women.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
হিমাচল প্রদেশের গ্রামীণ পরিবারগুলির জন্য পরিবারের আইডিগুলি এবং তাদের সংশ্লিষ্ট গ্রাম বা পাড়ার কোডগুলি চিহ্নিত করুন যাদের দুইয়ের বেশি বিবাহিত মহিলা রয়েছে।

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 14 and under.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
শহরের সকল পরিবার চিহ্নিত করুন যাদের ১৪ বছর বা তার কম বয়সের তিনটি以上的 শিশু আছে।

english_question: Rank the rural districts by the average number of married women per household, including only those districts with more than one household record.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
গ্রামীণ জেলাগুলিকে গৃহস্থালি প্রতি বিবাহিত মহিলাদের গড় সংখ্যা অনুসারে ক্রমবিন্যাস করুন, শুধুমাত্র সেইসব জেলাগুলি অন্তর্ভুক্ত করুন যাদের একাধিক গৃহস্থালি রেকর্ড রয়েছে।

english_question: Identify the five rural districts with the highest average number of married women per household.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:
প্রতিটি পরিবারে বিবাহিত মহিলাদের গড় সংখ্যা সর্বোচ্চ এমন পাঁচটি গ্রামীণ জেলা চিহ্নিত করুন।

english_question: List the IDs and member counts for households in rural Uttar Pradesh that are not classified as living below the poverty line.
translated_question:
এই প্রশ্নটি অনুবাদ করুন:

english_question: Identify all urban households that have more than three children aged 0 to 14, listed in ascending order of their IDs.

english_question: Identify the states and districts that are either classified as urban areas or contain households with more than three young residents aged 15 to 21.

english_question: List the states and districts that are either classified as urban or have more than three residents aged 15 to 21, sorted by state and district name.

english_question: List the household IDs and their corresponding asset indices for Dalit households located in rural areas of Uttar Pradesh, ordered by their asset index.

english_question: Rank the states by the average number of children aged 0 to 14 per household, including only those states with more than one recorded household.

english_question: List the states that have Dalit households categorized in the 15th asset index, sorted alphabetically.

english_question: Provide a state-wise breakdown of the average number of married women and the total number of children under 15 per household, categorized by urban and rural areas.

english_question: Provide a breakdown by state and urban/rural status showing the average number of married women and the total number of children under 15 per household, focusing only on areas where households average more than one married woman and ranking the results by the highest child population.

english_question: Identify the top 10 rural districts with the highest average household member counts, specifically focusing on those within the second neighborhood category.
